about_the_game:
Story Outline

After a family tragedy, a girl hid from reality with a self-made virtual reality headset, connecting only online. Her only bond is Nyx, a dear “Senpai,” who just vanished. When Nyx reappears—trapped in a complete digital world of 0s and 1s. Through the “Urban Legend Hunters” forum, the girl meets companions entering the supernatural “Meta ,” where reality and virtual collide.

Yet, they still did not know — an irreversible curse had already been triggered. The end was near, and the countdown to destruction between virtual and reality had begun.
Are you ready to dive into the depths of truth?

________________________

Game Features

  • Virtual Community x Immersive Experience: Interact with partner characters through virtual chatrooms, forums, and clue-hunting, advancing the story via immersive gameplay.

  • Unrealistic Multi-Threaded Reasoning: Gather information from the “Meta Space,” forums, and conversations with partners to piece together clues.

  • Choices Lead to Multiple Endings: A twisted and mysterious narrative where the player’s choices determine different endings.

  • Free 3D Exploration: Travel through multiple 3D spaces to uncover story-related information and unlock more character arcs.

________________________

Character Introduction

【 Protagonist 】

A girl who showed extraordinary programming talent from a young age. After a family tragedy, she grew reclusive, shutting herself off from the world and connecting only through a headset and the internet. When her “senpai” disappears, she receives mysterious clues from an unknown person and decides to investigate urban anomalies to find her. She cannot enter the Meta Space and must rely on her partners to explore.

【 Nyx 】

Called “Senpai” by the protagonist, but not actually from the same school. Beautiful, kind, and cheerful, embodying all traits of popularity. One day she mysteriously disappears, and neither the protagonist nor her friend Knox know her whereabouts.

【 Nox 】

Nyx’s friend with an androgynous appearance. Unlike the ever-cheerful Nyx, Knox is more grounded and serious. Cares about the protagonist and actively joins the investigation.

【 Mot noir mémo 】

Claims to be an engineer investigating urban legends to escape his own plight. A little neurotic, polite most of the time, but overly talkative on topics of interest, showing some otaku traits.

【 Amoraith 】

Claims to be connected to a TV station. Speaks with an old-fashioned politeness. Behaves like a knight of justice, protecting the weak, upholding principles, and believing that protecting children is a natural duty.

【 Morbos 】

A famous urban legend video creator. Speaks very fast, often about incomprehensible topics. Physically weak and occasionally hospitalized, but extremely active in his inner world.

【 Musashi 】

A timid and introverted girl, still a student and Nyx’s actual junior at school. Although she never had direct interaction with Nyx, she admires her greatly and actively helps the protagonist in the search.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-3230M CPU @ 2.60GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) HD Graphics 4000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: To rescue her best friend Nyx, who's trapped in a digital world, a girl and her friends explore and solve puzzles in the mysterious alternate dimension "Mata." The game features a virtual community, multi-threaded reasoning, and 3D exploration, immersing you in the story.
